_comment: RigCheck by ShackDesk — quick-start radio presets. Selecting one fills the connection fields; the operator can override any field. HamlibModelId is from `rigctl -l`. BaudRate 0 means let Hamlib use the model default. Popularity orders the list (higher first). Validate JSON at jsonlint.com before submitting. Community entries welcome — see CONTRIBUTING.md.

Name: Icom IC-7300
Notes: CI-V address default 0x94. USB cable to the radio's USB port; driver is Silicon Labs CP210x.

Name: Icom IC-705
Notes: CI-V address default 0xA4. USB cable to the radio's USB port.

Name: Yaesu FT-991A
Notes: USB cable to the radio's USB port. Set CAT RATE to 38400 in the radio menu.

Name: Yaesu FT-891
Notes: USB cable to the radio's USB port. Set CAT RATE in the radio menu to match.

Name: Yaesu FT-DX10
Notes: USB cable to the radio's USB port.

Name: Yaesu FT-DX101D
Notes: USB cable to the radio's USB port.

Name: Icom IC-7610
Notes: CI-V address default 0x98. The radio presents two COM ports; use the first (CI-V) one.

Name: Icom IC-9700
Notes: CI-V address default 0xA2. The radio presents two COM ports; use the first (CI-V) one.

Name: Kenwood TS-590SG
Notes: Enable hardware flow control (RTS/CTS) in the radio menu to match.
